claims.evidence: Joint liquidators' official site explicitly states company placed into liquidation on 27 June 2022 pursuant to the BVI court's order. Recognition petition paragraph1 and18 describes proceeding commencing 27 June; it also notes order entry on29 June. Story uses liquidation commencement, not claiming every procedural step occurred27 June.
claims.distinction: Not conflated with July Chapter15 filing.

claims.claim: Chapter15 petition filed 1 July 2022 in Southern District of New York
claims.evidence: Filed court document22-10920-mg Doc1 bears Filed07/01/22 stamp; foreign representatives' signatures dated07/01/2022. Liquidator Q&A describes foreign-recognition purpose and asset-preservation/stay relief.
claims.source_note: Filed primary court document reproduced by ArentFox Schiff; not an inference from a press-report publication date.
claims.distinction: Petition for recognition of existing foreign proceeding, not a newly invented July liquidation date. Book header keeps approved month precision JULY2022.

claims.claim: Voyager announced default on 15,250 BTC and350millionUSDC loan on27 June
claims.evidence: Issuer's27 June2022 press release announces notice of default for failure to make required payments and gives exact loan principal15,250BTC and350millionUSDC.
claims.distinction: Story dates the announcement, not a claim about the earlier legal delivery date of the notice. No fluctuating USD equivalent, total AUM, or current recoveries claimed.

claims.claim: Borrowing and creditor links transmitted distress; Voyager enteredChapter11 days later
claims.evidence: Voyager statement datelined5 July2022 (distributed6 July) describes Chapter11 petitions and cites prolonged crypto-market volatility/contagion and the3AC loan default. FSOC2022 BoxB printedpages38-40 (PDFpages40-42) documents reported counterparty links, lender losses and market exposures.
claims.qualifiers: Issuer explanation is attributed in story. FSOC's account summarizes public reports; it is not a judicial finding of every causal mechanism. Narrative connection between borrowing and transmitted losses is a synthesis of these documented links, not an assertion 3AC alone caused all2022 failures.

claims.claim: Market falls and repayment demands strained3AC
claims.evidence: Verified petition paragraphs1 and18 describe collapse amid cryptocurrency market fluctuations, defaults on loan obligations, creditors' demands and liquidation proceedings. FSOCBoxB describes reported exposures and leverage.
claims.omitted_to_avoid_overclaim: No invented leverage ratio, precise Terra/GBTC loss amounts, founder culpability finding, lender conspiracy, guaranteed recoveries or broad claim every crypto firm failed because of3AC.
